name: Black Basta Ransomware
description: Black Basta is a Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) group active since April 2022 that has impacted over 500 organizations globally across North America, Europe, and Australia. Affiliates gain initial access via Qakbot phishing, exploitation of ConnectWise ScreenConnect (CVE-2024-1709), and valid accounts purchased from Initial Access Brokers, then escalate privileges using ZeroLogon, PrintNightmare, and NoPac before deploying Cobalt Strike, Mimikatz, SoftPerfect NetScan, BITSAdmin, PsExec, RDP, ScreenConnect, and Splashtop for discovery and lateral movement. The group uses the Backstab tool to disable EDR/AV, exfiltrates data with RClone/WinSCP for double-extortion, and encrypts files with a ChaCha20 + RSA-4096 hybrid scheme, appending the .basta extension.
